nodes.label: ADR0001 fail-closed purchase progression
nodes.description: Adopts blocking immediate purchase, cart checkout and prepayment progression for owned/other confirmed duplicates. No override or automatic deletion; possible matches and unavailable lookup do not block.

nodes.label: Browser DOM library synchronization contract
nodes.description: Amazon,ebookjapan,Kobo readers collect visible DOM only under user-triggered bounded pagination. Strict schemas persist explicit states in library_observation; server projects purchased alone into listing, while price fields are absent. Canonical HTTPS source URLs,100-item batches,100-page visited-loop, readiness/login handling and path-limited injection are enforced. Provider authority and price permissions remain separate human gates.

nodes.label: Current-store library acceptance
nodes.description: Five existing DLsite/FANZA adapters expose flat nullable listing fields with provenance and purchase-date precision; missing values render 未取得, prices remain null, work only groups listings. Synthetic adapter,API and admin tests define acceptance without expanding new stores.

nodes.label: Issue42 historical integration audit
nodes.description: Fixed SHA9a72071 records partial visible DOM readers and price observations, safe display and design-only related-sales contract. Issues42-47 remained open at audit; provider authority, full purchase/current price semantics and related implementation were unresolved. Test run had stale shared/dist exports and missing happy-dom; report explicitly does not claim full-suite green.

nodes.label: Amazon Kindle research and reader
nodes.description: Initial scope Amazon.co.jp Kindle, single account; recommends marketplace+ASIN+format identity, separates purchase/free from rental,sample,KU,Prime and unknown. Official consumer-library API/export and extraction permission were unconfirmed. Later approved visible-DOM reader accepts exact10-character ASIN rows, explicit acquisition/rental labels, real visible product links and pager; no price fields, private API or credential access.

nodes.label: ebookjapan library research and reader
nodes.description: Research distinguishes Yahoo Japan Web purchase history from free/rental/gift access, records provisional publicationCd and unconfirmed API/permission/full-history guarantees. Visible-DOM reader uses strict bookshelf URL, observed shell and active purchased/free tabs, real product links and visible pagination; ambiguous states fail closed without price output.

nodes.label: Nullable library display and price contract
nodes.community_name: Nullable library display and price contract
nodes.description: Flat paginated listing response carries provenance-backed image/link, precision-qualified purchase date and nullable Money fields. Admin groups without inventing work-level aggregates. Implemented owned-only regular/sale/coupon price_observation stays independent from still-null purchasePrice/currentPrice; currency/tax/freshness must not be inferred. Related products remains design-only.
nodes.norm_label: nullable library display and price contract

nodes.label: Price observation acceptance
nodes.description: Accepted scope stores independent JPY regular/sale/coupon visible tiers for owned DLsite,FANZA Doujin and Books; server stamps UTC receipt and never creates ownership. Price sorts require explicit tier and currency, missing values last, ties workId/id; purchase/current prices remain null.

nodes.label: Rakuten Kobo research
nodes.description: Japan scope uses Rakuten ID and observed /e-book/kobo/library paths; distinguishes licensed purchase access,free,preview,preorder,archive and Kobo Plus. Recommends store-local ID plus region with separate ISBN and series metadata. Official automated acquisition permission/API/export remains unconfirmed, and cross-store bibliographic agreement is candidate evidence.

nodes.label: Related sales synthetic acceptance
nodes.description: Synthetic_related_v1 normalized import persists related_edge and market_offer, exposes related-products API and admin comparison. Relation evidence limited maker/author/series/store_related; unowned offers never enter listing. Supports owned exclude/mark and24hour fresh/stale/unavailable snapshots; real provider payload/fetch remains unimplemented.

nodes.label: Related products and market offer contract
nodes.community_name: Related products and market offer contract
nodes.description: Defines anchor source/cid, evidence-bearing relations, separate market_offer snapshots, canonical links, ownership filters, deterministic relevance/price/discount/end sorting and24hour freshness. Discount derivation requires comparable currency/tax, failures retain last snapshot, missing facts remain null. Updated header reports synthetic fixture implementation while historical design sections retain future source-adapter gates.
nodes.norm_label: related products and market offer contract

nodes.label: Owned FANZA DLsite price comparison
nodes.description: Read-only admin comparison consumes stored listing priceObservation for exactly DLsite,FANZA Doujin and Books, groups existing workId, preserves independent tiers and displays lowest only for at least2 values sharing currency and taxStatus; mismatch is incomparable. No fetch,matching,FX or shared-schema changes.

nodes.label: DLsite FANZA OSS scraper research
nodes.description: 2026-08-03 survey catalogs dlsite-userbuy,dlsite-purchased,dlsite-manager,SeihekiAnalyzer,DMM-PurchaseList,fanza-total-spending-extension,dmm-history and dmm-search3. Records observed API/DOM/ID patterns, stale hashed selectors and license limitations; DMM affiliate API supplies catalog metadata rather than purchase history.

nodes.label: Duplicate purchase prevention specification
nodes.description: Chrome MV3 extension fetches logged-in store APIs; local Node TypeScript server parses and persists SQLite work/listing/match_key. DLsite and FANZA first-wave intervention blocks confirmed duplicate purchase progression, permits cart addition, uses manual undoable deletion, and fails open when lookup unavailable. Exact normalized title matches merge automatically; same-maker Dice candidates require manual review. Export uses single-writer SQLite copy and read-only secondary clients.

nodes.label: ADP verification feature map
nodes.description: Defines navigation/URL entry evidence and four-section feature recipes for library, candidate queue, sync, settings and price comparison. Fresh baseline is empty; related comparison and extension are unmapped.

nodes.label: Isolated ADP admin verification harness
nodes.description: Launches one disposable Node22 server/SQLite and headless Chrome at a non-41321 loopback port with runtime identity, readiness checks and evidence. Drives admin UI only, keeps user instance isolated, refuses fabricated data and preserves evidence on cleanup.

nodes.label: Library verification
nodes.description: Proves default/nav entry, empty results and search miss; real search-hit and merge journeys require saved listings absent from baseline. Search requires submit and price sorting requires currency/tier.

nodes.label: Candidate queue verification
nodes.description: Proves navigation and empty queue; pair decisions require real existing pairs and must disappear after confirmation. Fresh launch lacks rows, so decision journey is unmet rather than seeded artificially.

nodes.label: Settings verification
nodes.description: Reads actual verification port and persists launch-provided absolute export directory; reload and GET settings provide second-view evidence. Saving does not rebind the running server.

nodes.label: Price-comparison verification
nodes.description: Reads stored DOM price observations for owned DLsite/FANZA work groups without store fetch; empty baseline cannot prove grouped regular/sale/coupon tiers. Missing tiers display unacquired.

nodes.label: Sync verification
nodes.description: Tests unsynced source rows and empty rematch with zero candidates; manual product registration calls the store and remains unrun without explicit network authorization. Empty rematch does not verify candidate decisions.
